executor.note: Engine versions (Kiro CLI, acpx, Codex/Claude ACP) are pinned inside the executor: config/engine-pins.json and package.json. accepts.images: digest-bound images in text-proposal requests (noteflow-agent-control#60); the installers derive PAI_EXECUTOR_IMAGES from it. 5696653: extended domain-data-proposal class, 180 s, three ordered Kiro keys, text only (#178), used by the workbench for long planning turns; 88c05b5: pre-exec launch evidence (#165) with the source commit from the install record in archive installs (#170); abe1d97: complete ACP activity inventory over the whole capture (#162); e392b3c: Kiro 2.28.0 (official stable, #156) and durable native transport capture (#155); 0836a0b: operator reconciliation of unknown-effect text attempts (#153) and append-only ledger policy extension (#154); earlier #96 (an acpx TIMEOUT is recorded as timeout with the partial answer) and #120 (Codex sessions use the pinned model via CODEX_CONFIG). The workbench uses the text-proposal class (60 s per attempt); the 180 s development-proposal class (#118) is reserved by its owner for the development writer.

physicsnemoCfd.note: Advisory aerodynamic prescreen only (native/cfd_prescreen.py); needs an NVIDIA GPU. The revision equals DOMINO_PACKAGE_ROOT in physicsnemo-cfd builtin_packages.py.

newton.note: Cross-engine conformance of the exported OpenUSD robot cell (native/usd_newton_check.py); CPU Warp, no GPU needed. Opt in: setup:physics -- --with-newton or PAI_PHYSICS_NEWTON=1.

freecad.note: CAM lane (native/cam_part.py via ocp-freecad-cam 2.0.2, which supports FreeCAD 1.1.x); lock native/cam-requirements.txt.

strandsRobots.note: Simulation only: mode='real', mesh and remote code are refused; assets are cloned once at setup at this commit and read offline.
